snippet.title: Delphinium - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
We’re excited to announce Delphinium, a bittersweet cozy farming sim coming soon! 💙🌿

Wishlist Today!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2943330/Delphinium/
Xbox: coming soon!
Gamepage: https://serenityforge.com/games/delphinium

Follow Haiyan as she returns to the quiet mountain village she once called home. Meet its residents, grow crops, and build connections that may shape an uncertain future.

Decorate your house, farm, cook, and cultivate relationships in a small mountain community. Over the course of a month, uncover a heartfelt story about memory, belonging, and hope. 🌱

✨ Wishlist Delphinium and follow the journey as we get closer to launch!
